newsitem.title: CHINA: China summer grain planting up 333,500 ha in 1997.
newsitem.headline: China summer grain planting up 333,500 ha in 1997.

text.p: China has planted an estimated 31.88 million hectares of summer grain this year, up 333,500 hectares from 1996, the Economic Daily said on Wednesday.
The total area planted with crops in 1997 could reach 153 million hectares, up 1.6 million hectares year-on-year, the newspaper said.
Of the total area planted, grain crops would increase slightly from 112 million hectares in 1996, it said.
The planted area of wheat, rice and beans would rise as would the area of oil-bearing and sugar crops, but the area under corn would fall somewhat, it said.
Wheat seedling growth in most of southern China and in the northwest was the best in two years, it said but gave no figures for expected harvests.
